data.raw_text:
Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, delivered a pre-recorded keynote speech at the ASEAN Space Situational Awareness (SSA) and Space Traffic Management (STM) Seminar held on 12 March 2026 in Manila, Philippines, jointly hosted by the Philippine Space Agency, Thailand’s Geo-Informatics and Space Technology Development Agency, and the United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (UNOOSA). 

In his remarks, Dr. Kao highlighted the growing congestion and risks in Earth’s orbit and underscored the need to strengthen regional cooperation on space safety and governance. He called on stakeholders to translate the dialogue into concrete actions that would feed into the anticipated ASEAN Leaders’ Declaration on Space Cooperation, expected to be adopted at the ASEAN Summit later this year in the Philippines.

Watch the full remarks: https://t.co/IgfBqx3WKt
